bio: Francesco Maria Colosimo was born in 1634. With his wife Giustina Berardello he had a son, Giovanni Antonio, baptized at San Mango D'Aquino in 1679. A Francesco Colosimo was buried at San Mango on 20 October 1692, which matches his recorded date of death.

summary: Francesco Maria Colosimo of San Mango D'Aquino (1634–1692), husband of Giustina Berardello; John's 8th-great-grandfather.
